Download MODIS product files using the shared download workflow

Source: R/source-modis.R
download_modis.Rd

Query NASA CMR for file URLs, prepare a download table, and download MODIS or VIIRS files using the shared validation, preview, download, and return helpers.

Usage

download_modis(
  product = c("MOD09GA", "MYD09GA", "MOD09GQ", "MYD09GQ", "MOD09A1", "MYD09A1",
    "MOD09Q1", "MYD09Q1", "MOD11A1", "MYD11A1", "MOD11A2", "MYD11A2", "MOD11B1",
    "MYD11B1", "MOD13A1", "MYD13A1", "MOD13A2", "MYD13A2", "MOD13Q1", "MYD13Q1",
    "MOD13A3", "MYD13A3", "MCD12Q1", "MOD14A1", "MYD14A1", "MOD14A2", "MYD14A2",
    "MOD14CM1", "MYD14CM1", "MOD16A2", "MYD16A2", "MCD64A1", "MCD64CMQ", "MOD06_L2",
    "MCD14ML", "MCD19A2", "VNP46A2", "VNP64A1"),
  version = "061",
  nasa_earth_data_token = NULL,
  date = c("2023-09-01", "2023-09-01"),
  extent = c(-125, 22, -64, 50),
  directory_to_save = NULL,
  acknowledgement = FALSE,
  download = TRUE,
  remove_command = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  hash = FALSE,
  max_tries = 20,
  rate_limit = 2
)

Arguments

product

character(1). Supported MODIS or VIIRS product code. The default selects the first listed product.

version

character(1). Requested CMR version, default "061". Existing product-specific overrides are retained; see Details.

nasa_earth_data_token

character(1) or NULL. NASA Earthdata token, token-file path, or NULL to use NASA_EARTHDATA_TOKEN. Resolved by get_token(), which checks the environment variable first.

date

character(1 or 2). Single date or range endpoints in "YYYY-MM-DD" format. Endpoints may be supplied in either order.

extent

numeric(4). Bounding box in decimal degrees, ordered c(west, south, east, north). Default covers the continental US.

directory_to_save

character(1). Non-empty output directory. Files are saved directly in this directory.

acknowledgement

logical(1). Must be TRUE to proceed.

download

logical(1). Deprecated. FALSE warns and returns a preview after token lookup, directory creation, and discovery. Discovery still queries CMR in preview mode; data files are not downloaded.

remove_command

logical(1). Deprecated and ignored; TRUE warns.

show_progress

logical(1). Show per-file download progress. Discovery and summary messages may still be printed when FALSE.

hash

logical(1). Return the combined directory MD5 hash when TRUE. Ignored when download = FALSE.

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum attempts per CMR or file request, including the first attempt. Default is 20.

rate_limit

numeric(1). Non-negative request-throttling interval in seconds, passed to discovery and downloads. Default is 2. Discovery uses a capacity-one bucket; 0 disables discovery throttling. File downloads follow the throttling policy in download_run_method().

Value

With download = FALSE, an invisible preview list containing urls, destfiles, and n_files. Otherwise, with hash = FALSE, the invisible download summary from download_run_method(). With hash = TRUE, a visible combined MD5 hash for all files under directory_to_save.

The download summary always contains success, failed, skipped, failed_urls, and failed_files. The two failure vectors are character(0) when no files failed, including when every file was skipped.

Details

Product-specific version overrides and a CM1-to-A2 fallback are applied before filename date filtering. Files use a flat destination directory. MOD06_L2 uses "6.1"; MOD14CM1/MYD14CM1 use "005"; MCD64CMQ uses "006"; MCD14ML uses "6.1NRT"; VNP46A2/VNP64A1 omit the version filter. An empty CM1 response triggers the existing A2 version "006" fallback.

Cross-year ranges remain restricted to MOD06_L2, MOD14CM1, MYD14CM1, MCD14ML, MCD64A1, MCD64CMQ, and VNP64A1. Discovery retrieves successive CMR pages of up to 2000 granules using the CMR-Search-After response header. There is no 31-day warning or restriction. The query parameters, retry settings, timeout, and throttle are retained across pages.

When supplied, CMR-Hits is checked against the number of retrieved granule records before link or date filtering. Discovery stops if a page request fails, the reported count changes, a required continuation value is missing or repeated, or the final record count does not match CMR-Hits.

CMR supplies actual file URLs, so a product/date Cartesian grid is not needed. The inclusive date sequence is used to establish ordered query endpoints. A file count is reported without claiming daily or monthly completeness for tiled, swath, or composite products.

Discovery keeps the existing 120-second per-attempt timeout; file downloads use download_run_method()'s default timeout.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_modis(
  product = "MOD09GA",
  date = c("2024-01-01", "2024-01-03"),
  extent = c(-80, 35, -75, 40),
  directory_to_save = file.path(tempdir(), "modis"),
  acknowledgement = TRUE,
  download = FALSE
)
} # }
